name: openbb_equity_metrics
description:
Key valuation and profitability metrics for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.metrics): P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, ROE, ROA, margins, growth, dividend yield.
Returns: {symbol, period, metrics: [records, one per period for fmp, a single current record for yfinance]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (annual or quarter; default annual; used by fmp); limit (1-100 periods; default 5; used by fmp); provider (fmp, intrinio or yfinance; default fmp).
Ratios table: openbb_equity_fundamental_ratios; other source: av_company_overview. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "yfinance"}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
